def _membership_cart_position(event, item, membership=None, subevent=None):
    return CartPosition.objects.create(
        item=item, price=23, expires=now() + timedelta(days=1), event=event, cart_id="123",
        used_membership=membership, subevent=subevent,
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_no_membership_required(event, customer):
    item = Item.objects.create(event=event, name='Ticket', default_price=Decimal('23.00'), admission=True)
    cp = _membership_cart_position(event, item)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, lock=True, testmode=False)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_valid(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, lock=True, testmode=False)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_missing(event, customer, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='requires an active membership'):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_missing_customer(event, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='not valid for this product'):
        validate_memberships_in_order(None, [cp], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_of_other_customer(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    other = event.organizer.customers.create(email="jane@example.org")
    membership.customer = other
    membership.save()
    cp = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='not valid for this product'):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_wrong_type(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    other_type = event.organizer.membership_types.create(name="Half pass")
    membership.membership_type = other_type
    membership.save()
    cp = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='not valid for this product'):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_canceled(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.canceled = True
    membership.save()
    cp = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='not valid for this product'):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_testmode_mismatch(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.testmode = True
    membership.save()
    cp = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='not valid for this product'):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, testmode=False)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, testmode=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_expired_for_event_date(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.date_start -= timedelta(days=100)
    membership.date_end -= timedelta(days=100)
    membership.save()
    cp = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='date of this product'):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_valid_from_not_chosen(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    # Membership starts after the event, so the date check fails unless it is skipped in the membership step
    membership.date_start = datetime(2021, 5, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ)
    membership.date_end = datetime(2099, 5, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ)
    membership.save()
    cp = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='date of this product'):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, valid_from_not_chosen=False)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, valid_from_not_chosen=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_max_usages_within_purchase(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership.membership_type.allow_parallel_usage = True
    membership.membership_type.save()
    cp1 = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    cp2 = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='maximum number of times'):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_parallel_usage(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp1 = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    cp2 = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='starting at the same time'):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)

    membership.membership_type.allow_parallel_usage = True
    membership.membership_type.save()
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_max_usages_with_existing_order(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership.membership_type.allow_parallel_usage = True
    membership.membership_type.save()
    q = event.quotas.create(size=None, name="foo")
    q.items.add(requiring_ticket)
    cp1 = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    order = _create_order(event, email='dummy@example.org', positions=[cp1],
                          now_dt=now(),
                          sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
                          payment_requests=[{
                              "id": "test0",
                              "provider": "banktransfer",
                              "max_value": None,
                              "min_value": None,
                              "multi_use_supported": False,
                              "info_data": {},
                              "payment_amount": Decimal("23.00"),
                              "pprov": BankTransfer(event)
                          }],
                          locale='de', customer=customer)[0]

    cp2 = _membership_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match='maximum number of times'):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp2], event)
    # The order that is being changed does not count against the usage limit
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp2], event, ignored_order=order)
